test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a line, five friends P, Q, R, S and T are sitting, all facing East. P is sitting at the second place to the left of T. R is third to the left of S and also to the immediate right of P. Which two persons are sitting at the corners?
solution: The logic followed here is :- In a line, five friends P, Q, R, S and T are sitting, all facing East. 1) R is third to the left of S and also to the immediate right of P.
